register(address,address,bytes32).details: Groups are implicitly created when the first user registers. A user is in a group's referral tree if they have been referred or have referred others.

params.groupId: The group ID (group is auto-created on first registration)
params.referrer: The referrer address (must be in the group's referral tree, or REFERRAL_ROOT for root registration)

rewardLeaf(bytes32,bytes32,address,addre.details: Same authorization, deadline, payer binding, rewardId namespace, fee and `user` checks as rewardRoots, but      signed over the distinct `RewardLeaf` typehash, so a RewardRoots signature cannot be used here and vice versa.

params.deadline: Last timestamp (inclusive) at which the signature is valid
params.oracle: Oracle that signed (EOA or ERC-1271 contract); must be authorized for `groupId`
params.rewardId: Oracle-chosen idempotency key / signature nonce (shared namespace with rewardRoots)
params.signature: ECDSA signature or ERC-1271 signature blob over the RewardLeaf digest
params.totalAmount: Gross amount. Protocol fee (if any) is deducted first; `user` receives the remainder. Caller approves exactly `totalAmount`.

rewardRoots(bytes32,bytes32,address,addr.details: Authorization is an EIP-712 `RewardRoots` signature from `oracle`, which must be authorized for `groupId`      (checked at execution time, so unauthorizing an oracle invalidates its outstanding signatures). A 65- or      64-byte (EIP-2098) signature is first checked with ecrecover against `oracle` (EOAs, including      EIP-7702-delegated EOAs); if that does not match and `oracle` has code, ERC-1271 `isValidSignature` is used      (no ERC-6492). Anyone may submit, but the signed `payer` must equal `msg.sender`; all tokens are pulled from      `msg.sender`. `rewardId` is the nonce, shared with rewardLeaf: each id is used at most once per group.      `user` must be registered in the group. Does not retain a token balance.

params.deadline: Last timestamp (inclusive) at which the signature is valid
params.oracle: Oracle that signed (EOA or ERC-1271 contract); must be authorized for `groupId`
params.signature: ECDSA signature or ERC-1271 signature blob over the RewardRoots digest
params.totalAmount: Gross amount. Protocol fee (if any) is deducted first; the remainder is split across the referral chain. Caller approves exactly `totalAmount`.

setProtocolFee(uint16,address).details: `bps == 0` charges nothing. A non-zero fee requires a recipient. Reverts with FeeTooHigh above MAX_FEE_BPS (1000 = 10%).

params.bps: Fee in basis points of `totalAmount`, deducted from `totalAmount` before the reward is paid
params.recipient: Address that receives the protocol fee

setSkiplisted(address,bytes32,bool).details: Only callable by an oracle authorized for `groupId`

params.skiplisted: True to skiplist, false to remove

returns._0: Length of the skiplist (no extra storage)

params.groupId: The group to remove authorization from

authorizeOracle(address,bytes32).notice: Authorize an oracle to register referrals in a group

batchRegister(address[],address,bytes32).notice: Batch register multiple users with the same referrer in a group

feeBps().notice: Global protocol fee in basis points. 10000 = 100%; capped at MAX_FEE_BPS (1000 = 10%). Defaults to 0.

feeRecipient().notice: Recipient of the protocol fee charged on rewardRoots / rewardLeaf

getAncestors(address,bytes32,uint256).notice: Get the ancestor chain for a user in a group (from user up to root)

getAuthorizedOracles(bytes32).notice: Get all authorized oracles for a group

getChildren(address,bytes32).notice: Get the children of a referrer in a group

getPayoutAncestors(address,bytes32,uint2.notice: Get ancestors with skiplisted addresses removed (does not count them toward maxLevels)

getPayoutChain(address,bytes32,uint256).notice: Build the payout chain starting from `user`, omitting skiplisted addresses

getReferrer(address,bytes32).notice: Get the referrer of a user in a group

getSkiplisted(bytes32).notice: Get all skiplisted addresses for a group

isAuthorizedOracle(address,bytes32).notice: Check if an address is an authorized oracle for a group

isRegistered(address,bytes32).notice: Check if a user is registered in a group

isSkiplisted(address,bytes32).notice: Check if an address is on the skip list for a group

register(address,address,bytes32).notice: Register a user with a referrer in a group

registeredCount(bytes32).notice: Number of successfully registered users in a group (excludes REFERRAL_ROOT)

rewardLeaf(bytes32,bytes32,address,addre.notice: Pull `totalAmount` of `token` from the caller, take any protocol fee from it, pay the remainder to         `user` directly, and emit LeafRewarded

rewardRoots(bytes32,bytes32,address,addr.notice: Pull `totalAmount` of `token` from the caller, take any protocol fee from it, split the remainder across         `user`'s skiplist-aware payout chain, and emit RootsRewarded

setProtocolFee(uint16,address).notice: Set the global protocol fee. Only the owner.

setRewardCalculator(address).notice: Set the reward calculator. Only the owner.

setSkiplisted(address,bytes32,bool).notice: Add or remove an address from a group's skip list

skiplistedCount(bytes32).notice: Number of currently skiplisted addresses in a group

unauthorizeOracle(address,bytes32).notice: Unauthorize an oracle for a group
